summary: Renames CHOP channels using pattern matching and replacement while leaving channel values and channel order unchanged.

key_params.name: renameto
key_params.note: Replacement pattern for matched channel names

key_concepts: Rename CHOP changes channel names while leaving channel values and channel order untouched.
The From field uses CHOP pattern matching, and the To field uses pattern replacement.
Channels that do not match the From pattern pass through without name changes.
An optional second Name Reference input overrides From/To and names the first input channels from the second input order.
Rename CHOP is the focused tool for channel-name normalization; use Select CHOP when filtering or reordering is also required.
common_gotchas: Only channel names change; samples, values, and channel order are not affected.
From uses CHOP pattern matching while To uses pattern replacement syntax.
If the optional second Name Reference input is connected, From and To are ignored and output names follow the second input channel order.
For simple zero-valued renames, adding a Constant CHOP through a Math CHOP can sometimes be enough.
Use Select CHOP when the planner needs to filter or reorder channels as well as rename them.
